restoration.exact_candidate_bytes: For each candidate, restore topic/path from fixed_candidate_restore_commit or the exact Git blob. The original byte count and original recorded SHA identify the primary; no scientific rerun is needed for byte restoration.
restoration.source_and_input_bytes: Use the registry's explicit commit/path/blob/size and complete original manifests. Old sources at their original basename/cwd remain authoritative; current same-spelling metadata does not replace old hard pins.
restoration.recomputation: Every original command/resource, complete plan and source remains. If scientific recomputation is later requested, it uses those full inputs/definitions and Actions; it is not a requirement of this retention and is not promised bitwise identical to archived outputs.
restoration.scratch_arrays: Never-committed geometry chunks are identified by full original manifests and regeneration plans; their present availability or Git recovery is not asserted.
restoration.protected: No complete source, original config/plan/input/checkpoint/array, full proof, resource, request, port, runtime source, unknown Nelder source or live scientific output is deleted here.
restoration.implementation: Root performs a fresh metadata match for exactly these 12 paths and can then publish the complete small records and remove the selected tree entries in one ordinary non-forced commit. A mismatching path is not silently substituted.

full_parameter_location_contract: The twelve selected-output resource objects are copied in full. Every related/failed resource is retained in its original complete file, identified by exact record; all its original argv, signals, timing and resource fields remain there unchanged. No source parameter is omitted from or altered in the original records.
